My mistake — the link isn't on `athlete.md`. That page only mentions plate-pool in a kit-mapping line, no link. The "Set up the home kit in plate-pool" link is at the top (line 7) of every routine page instead:

- `pages/routines/mon-ohp.md`
- `pages/routines/wed-pull-up.md`
- `pages/routines/fri-squat.md`
- `pages/routines/sat-bench.md`
- `pages/routines/sun-deadlift.md`
- `pages/routines/daily-hang.md`
- `pages/routines/cond-circuit.md`

So on your phone, open any routine page in the published repo (`github.com/joeuk89/training`, under `pages/routines/`) and tap the first link, "Set up the home kit in plate-pool". It carries the full inventory in the URL fragment, and once you've opened it once the "Load it in plate-pool" links on the same page will work with the short `kit=d33b57cc` form.
